Detailed Description

wpa_ctrl client class.

This class manages the wpa_ctrl connections to hostapd/wpa_supplicate for all registered VAPs using wpa_client APIs. Each registered VAP is managed using wpa_ctrl sockets for:

  • synchronous requests command
  • unsolicited events

Register interface to wpa_ctrl client. This method creates resources (sockets) for handling command and events of this interface, to/from hostapd/wpa_supplicant.

Parameters
[in]interfaceName of the interface.
[in]pathWpa_ctrl socket file path (commonly: /var/run/<hostapd/wpa_supplicant>/<ifName>).
[in]event_fdsReference to vector of file descriptors to be filled, for event monitoring.
Returns
bool True if interface is added , or exists with same path, False othewise.
